title: Maximum Distinct Path Sum in a Binary Tree
summary: Given a binary tree with integer node values, find the maximum sum of a path where all node values are distinct.
statement: Given a binary tree with integer node values, find the maximum sum of a path where all node values are distinct. The path can start and end at any node and does not need to include the root.
constraints: The tree is nonempty and node values may be negative.
A path may start and end at any nodes connected through parent-child edges.
All values on the path must be distinct; maximize their sum.
